objectives.description: Explicit include/exclude call for document-authoring agents in filetypes/, present/, founder/
objectives.note: 30 candidate agents assessed (7 filetypes + 14 founder + 9 present). INCLUDED (10, write outside specs/**): filetypes/document-agent, filetypes/docx-edit-agent, filetypes/filetypes-spreadsheet-agent, filetypes/presentation-agent, filetypes/scrape-agent, filetypes/sheet-agent (all write to caller-supplied absolute paths, not scoped to specs/); founder/deck-builder-agent (writes to strategy/{slug}-deck/); founder/meeting-agent (writes to same directory as user-supplied notes_path, typically outside specs/); present/pptx-assembly-agent and present/slidev-assembly-agent (both write to talks/{N}_{slug}/). EXCLUDED (20, recorded explicitly, not by oversight): filetypes/filetypes-router-agent (no Write tool -- pure Task-delegation router, does not author files itself); founder/analyze-agent, founder/deck-planner-agent, founder/deck-research-agent, founder/finance-agent, founder/financial-analysis-agent, founder/founder-plan-agent, founder/founder-spreadsheet-agent, founder/legal-analysis-agent, founder/legal-council-agent, founder/market-agent, founder/project-agent, founder/strategy-agent (all verified via grep of their MUST DO/Write bullets and body text: every deliverable -- report, XLSX, JSON metrics, plan, draft -- is written under specs/{NNN}_{SLUG}/, none write outside specs/**); present/budget-agent, present/funds-agent, present/grant-agent, present/slide-critic-agent, present/slide-planner-agent, present/slides-research-agent, present/timeline-agent (same: all outputs -- reports, XLSX, JSON, drafts, plans -- verified written under specs/{NNN}_{SLUG}/).
